FY2026.classification: Identified investment diagnostic adjusted for known inventory-to-PPE transfers and finance-lease additions; not complete invested-capital reconciliation.
FY2026.sourceFields: FY2026 10-K p46 noncash-transactions schedule and p64 lease additions, together with identified NWC and cash capex.
FY2026.capitalPayableLimitation: Capital-payable location within trade AP versus other accruals is not disclosed. This diagnostic has not been fully normalized for capital-payable movements, acquisition/FX effects, or other omitted working-capital balances. Do not label it exact cash reinvestment.

limitations: Prepaid and other assets excluded because component taxonomy unavailable; other current/long-term operating balances not fully mapped. Latest NWC measure is identified subset, not complete invested capital.
Historical core-trade proxy is AR+inventory-AP only, not full operating NWC.
Finance leases treated as financing; normalize future additions within aggregate investment. Operating leases remain operating costs.
FY2024 had53weeks; other nearby years52weeks. Acquisition, FX and noncash balances affect cash-flow comparison.

Management3bn+ five-year labs is a planned gross investment, not an extra debt claim or an annual schedule. Firstfiveyears net-investment floor300m is an analyst downside allowance, not a reported contractual minimum.

Known inventory-to-PPE transfers and finance-lease additions are included in the adjusted FY2026 diagnostic. Earlier five-year proxy remains unadjusted; neither is a complete cash investment reconciliation.

Opening capital payables are excluded by definition from the forward normalized operating-investment model; the legacy cash settlement is separately funded once in year 1. Reported historical AP cannot be fully decomposed and is a diagnostic only.

RAndDSensitivity.policy: Diagnostic only. Base already expenses R&D; do not add it to base reinvestment without adjusting operating income, capital, taxes and amortization consistently.

historicalCoreProxyFiveYearMarginalSales: Unadjusted cash-capex plus core-trade balance-sheet proxy; incomplete and not directly equivalent to the adjusted latest-year diagnostic.

contractualCommitments.guaranteeTreatment: No probable material payment reported by issuer; contingent exposure disclosed, not added as debt.
contractualCommitments.transitionTax: Remaining transition tax obligation settled in FY2026; no new opening transition-tax deduction.
contractualCommitments.labPlan: More than 3000 over five years announced August 26, 2026, not an exact annual contractual schedule.
contractualCommitments.policy: Ordinary purchase costs belong in EBIT/NWC and capital purchases in investment. Do not deduct these totals as financing claims in addition to modeled cash flows. The 300 normalized net-investment floor is an analyst allowance, not proof the annual gross-capex plan is funded.
